about.title: Corporate Profile
about.subtitle: Arshia Global BD (Pvt.) Limited — established to serve Bangladesh's growing built environment and trade economy.
paragraphs: The name of the Company is Arshia Global BD (Pvt.) Limited. The registered office of the Company shall be situated in Bangladesh.

The Company is established to carry on diversified business activities including real estate development, construction and contracting, infrastructure engineering, property management, import-export and supply of construction and textile products, engineering and architectural consultancy, IT-enabled services, and participation in government procurement through the e-GP System and BPPA. All objects are implemented after obtaining necessary permission from the Government or concerned competent authority before commencement of business.

services.title: Real Estate
services.shortDesc: End-to-end property development, sales, leasing, investment, and asset management across Bangladesh.
services.longDesc: Arshia Global BD carries on the business of real estate, apartments, land, buildings, supermarkets, shopping complexes, community centers, and all forms of permissible property within Bangladesh and elsewhere. We arrange development, purchase, sale, lease, sub-lease, and letting out of residential flats and commercial spaces through both online and offline platforms.
details: We hold, operate, and manage properties for investment, rental income, and commercial purposes — appointing agents, consultants, attorneys, and property managers as required for each transaction.
Our team supports landowners, developers, and investors with market analysis, legal due diligence, title verification, and structured deal documentation aligned with Bangladesh property law.
scope: Appointment of agents, consultants & legal advisors

processSteps.title: Requirement & Site Assessment
processSteps.desc: Understand client goals, budget, and location preferences; shortlist viable land or existing assets.

processSteps.title: Legal & Title Verification
processSteps.desc: Conduct due diligence, mutation checks, and documentation review before any commitment.

processSteps.title: Development or Transaction
processSteps.desc: Execute purchase, sale, lease, or development plan with appointed consultants and contractors.

processSteps.title: Marketing & Handover
processSteps.desc: List, promote, and close deals through online/offline channels; manage handover and occupancy.

processSteps.title: Ongoing Asset Management
processSteps.desc: Provide rental collection, maintenance coordination, and portfolio reporting where retained.

services.targetSectors: Residential apartments, commercial retail, land investors, shopping complexes, community centers, mixed-use developers
services.typicalTeam: Real Estate Advisor, Legal Consultant, Property Manager, Marketing Coordinator, Site Liaison Officer
services.tools: GIS mapping, financial modeling, online property portals, CRM & document management
services.methodology: We develop, purchase, sell, lease, and manage properties through a structured pipeline — from site selection and legal clearance to marketing, transaction closure, and optional long-term asset management.
services.compliance: All property transactions follow applicable land registration, RAJUK/local authority, and tax requirements; business commenced only after necessary permissions.

services.title: Contractor
services.shortDesc: 1st class construction, builders, engineering works, and turnkey project delivery with full utility approvals.
services.longDesc: As a 1st class contractor and builder, we acquire land, develop sites, and construct multi-storied residential buildings, housing estates, shopping complexes, and office towers for commercial or residential occupancy. We manage the full construction lifecycle from planning and approvals through handover.
details: We obtain and coordinate approvals from RAJUK, WASA, Titas Gas Transmission Authority, DESCO, and relevant local authorities before commencement of work.
Our civil engineering team supervises structural works, MEP coordination, finishing, and quality audits to deliver safe, durable buildings on schedule.
scope: RAJUK, WASA, Titas Gas & DESCO liaison

processSteps.title: Pre-Construction Planning
processSteps.desc: Review drawings, BOQ, schedule, and regulatory requirements; mobilize site and approvals.

processSteps.title: Authority Clearances
processSteps.desc: Secure RAJUK construction approval and utility connections (WASA, gas, power).

processSteps.title: Substructure & Superstructure
processSteps.desc: Execute foundation, frame, masonry, and structural works per approved engineering design.

processSteps.title: MEP & Finishing
processSteps.desc: Complete electrical, plumbing, HVAC, lifts, and interior/exterior finishing to specification.

processSteps.title: Testing, Handover & Warranty
processSteps.desc: Conduct inspections, occupancy readiness, and handover with defect liability coverage.

services.timeline: 3 – 24 months depending on building scale and approval cycles
services.targetSectors: Private developers, housing projects, commercial towers, retail complexes, institutional clients
services.typicalTeam: Chief Engineer, Site Supervisor, Safety Officer, RAJUK Liaison Officer, QA/QC Inspector, Planning Engineer
services.tools: AutoCAD, MS Project, BIM coordination, daily site reporting apps, material testing logs
services.methodology: We deliver construction as a 1st class contractor with staged approvals, weekly progress tracking, material quality audits, and transparent client reporting from mobilization to handover.
services.compliance: Worker safety standards, building codes, environmental norms, and all statutory utility and construction permits obtained before work begins.

services.title: Infrastructure
services.shortDesc: Roads, bridges, commercial complexes, institutional buildings, and land development at national scale.
services.longDesc: We undertake development and construction of multi-storied commercial buildings, office complexes, department stores, hotels, shopping centres, cinema houses, and educational institutions. We also deliver civil infrastructure — roads, highways, bridges, reservoirs, factories, and other engineering works.
details: Land plotting, real estate development, and property brokerage services complement our infrastructure portfolio for integrated township and corridor projects.
Projects are executed with survey control, geotechnical input, traffic management plans, and maintenance handover documentation for public and private clients.

processSteps.title: Feasibility & Survey
processSteps.desc: Topographic survey, soil investigation, and route/alignment studies for infrastructure scope.

processSteps.title: Design & Approvals
processSteps.desc: Engineering design, BOQ preparation, and authority/consultant approval coordination.

processSteps.title: Earthworks & Foundation
processSteps.desc: Clearing, grading, piling, and substructure works per geotechnical recommendations.

processSteps.title: Superstructure & Pavement
processSteps.desc: Bridge decks, building frames, road layers, and drainage installation.

processSteps.title: Commissioning & Maintenance Plan
processSteps.desc: Final inspection, as-built documentation, and maintenance schedule handover.

services.timeline: 6 – 36 months based on project scale and weather/access constraints
services.targetSectors: Government agencies, private developers, industrial parks, educational trusts, hospitality investors
services.typicalTeam: Infrastructure Engineer, Civil Contractor, Project Manager, Surveyor, Traffic & Safety Coordinator
services.tools: AutoCAD, Civil 3D, MS Project, GIS survey tools, drone mapping (where applicable)
services.methodology: Infrastructure projects follow phased engineering delivery — survey and design validation, staged construction with quality hold points, and documented handover for long-term maintainability.
services.compliance: Environmental clearance, structural safety certification, and authority permits obtained prior to commencement; ongoing site safety monitoring.

services.title: Export-Import
services.shortDesc: International trade in construction, textile, machinery, and engineering goods with full logistics support.
services.longDesc: We operate as importers, exporters, suppliers, distributors, indenters, traders, and commission agents for construction materials, building supplies, engineering goods, machinery, equipment, tools, engineering chemicals, textile products, fabrics, garments, yarn, fibres, and allied products.
details: End-to-end trade services include supplier sourcing, letter of credit facilitation, customs clearance, inland transportation, warehousing, and repackaging for project or factory delivery.
We serve manufacturers, contractors, and retailers with competitive landed pricing, compliant documentation, and shipment tracking from origin port to final destination.

processSteps.title: Inquiry & Sourcing
processSteps.desc: Identify specifications, supplier options, and landed cost estimates for client approval.

processSteps.title: Commercial & Shipping Docs
processSteps.desc: Prepare PI/PO, LC or TT terms, packing lists, and shipping instructions.

processSteps.title: Customs & Port Clearance
processSteps.desc: Manage import/export declarations, duty payment, and port handling.

processSteps.title: Warehousing & Distribution
processSteps.desc: Store, consolidate, and dispatch goods to project sites or factory locations nationwide.

processSteps.title: Post-Delivery Support
processSteps.desc: Handle claims, short-shipment resolution, and repeat order planning.

services.timeline: 2 – 8 weeks from order confirmation to delivery (shipment & customs dependent)
services.targetSectors: Construction firms, garment manufacturers, industrial plants, distributors, government procurement
services.typicalTeam: Trade Manager, Customs Broker, Logistics Coordinator, Documentation Officer, Warehouse Supervisor
services.tools: ERP trade modules, customs e-filing, freight tracking portals, inventory & bond management systems
services.methodology: Trade operations run on documented purchase-to-delivery workflows with verified suppliers, compliant shipping papers, and tracked logistics at every milestone.
services.compliance: Bangladesh import-export regulations, HS code classification, LC/TT banking norms, and ethical sourcing standards applied to all shipments.

services.title: Supplier
services.shortDesc: Nationwide distribution, stocking, and supply of construction materials, equipment, and industrial products.
services.longDesc: We import, export, purchase, sell, distribute, stock, store, market, and deal in construction materials, building supplies, industrial equipment, and textile products. We serve contractors, developers, manufacturers, and businesses with reliable supply chain coverage.
details: Bulk and scheduled deliveries are supported from warehouse stock or direct mill/factory procurement with quality certificates and batch traceability where required.
Dedicated account management helps repeat clients with annual rate contracts, just-in-time delivery windows, and consolidated invoicing.

processSteps.title: Requirement Capture
processSteps.desc: Confirm specifications, quantities, delivery schedule, and site access constraints.

processSteps.title: Procurement & QC
processSteps.desc: Source from approved vendors; inspect and document quality before dispatch.

processSteps.title: Stock & Pick
processSteps.desc: Allocate from warehouse inventory or trigger direct supplier shipment.

processSteps.title: Logistics & Delivery
processSteps.desc: Route planning, loading, and proof-of-delivery to site or factory.

processSteps.title: Invoice & Reorder
processSteps.desc: Close billing cycle and set up repeat supply schedules where applicable.

services.timeline: 1 – 4 weeks for standard stocked items; longer for specialized imports
services.targetSectors: Contractors, developers, garment factories, manufacturing plants, retail hardware dealers
services.typicalTeam: Supply Chain Manager, Procurement Specialist, Quality Inspector, Warehouse Team Lead, Delivery Coordinator
services.tools: Inventory management system, supplier portals, mobile POD capture, quality audit checklists
services.methodology: Supply operations prioritize certified products, optimized bulk logistics, and transparent order tracking from PO confirmation through proof of delivery.
services.compliance: Supplier quality audits, material test certificates where applicable, and accurate tax invoicing on all supply transactions.

services.title: Consultancy & e-GP
services.shortDesc: Engineering consultancy, ITES, feasibility studies, and government procurement through e-GP & BPPA.
services.longDesc: We provide engineering, architectural, and general consultancy including feasibility studies, project profiles, surveying, and technical proposals. Our ITES division delivers software development, real estate management systems, and digital marketing solutions.
details: We participate in e-GP, BPPA, and other public procurement platforms — preparing tenders, submitting bids, executing awarded contracts, and completing handover for government, semi-government, and private sector clients.
Consultancy engagements cover pre-investment studies, detailed project reports, supervision services, and post-implementation reviews aligned with client funding and approval requirements.

processSteps.title: Scope & Terms Definition
processSteps.desc: Agree consultancy or tender scope, timeline, deliverables, and fee structure.

processSteps.title: Study / Proposal Development
processSteps.desc: Prepare feasibility, DPP, drawings, or compliant tender documents.

processSteps.title: Submission & Approval
processSteps.desc: Submit to client or e-GP portal; respond to queries and clarifications.

processSteps.title: Execution & Supervision
processSteps.desc: Deliver consultancy milestones or implement awarded contract works.

processSteps.title: Completion & Reporting
processSteps.desc: Final reports, as-built documentation, and procurement closure certificates.

services.timeline: 2 – 12 weeks for studies; contract duration varies by tender award
services.targetSectors: Government ministries, LGED-type agencies, private developers, NGOs, international organizations
services.typicalTeam: Consultant Engineer, Architect, IT Specialist, Procurement Officer, Project Manager, Survey Team
services.tools: e-GP portal, BPPA systems, MS Project, REMS platforms, CAD & estimation software
services.methodology: Consultancy and procurement services combine technical rigour with compliance-first documentation — every study, bid, and deliverable is structured for auditability and client approval gates.
services.compliance: e-GP/BPPA procurement rules, PPR 2008 alignment, IT policy where applicable, and all business activities undertaken after required government permissions.
